long.title: How to Get Rid of Ants in Your House (Without Spraying Chemicals Near Food)
long.description:
Ants in the kitchen or the garden? In this step-by-step video you'll learn how to get rid of ants naturally: find the trail and entry point, clean up food and water sources, erase scent trails with vinegar, seal entry points with caulk, use natural deterrents like cinnamon and food-grade diatomaceous earth, deal with aphids and nests in the garden, and know when to call a professional. No harsh pesticides.

You'll need: white vinegar and water, a spray bottle, food-grade diatomaceous earth, caulk, a soapy sponge.

WikiTube publishes a new step-by-step how-to video every day. Subscribe so you don't miss the next one.
